CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTMAPPING_LNS
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping
AS(
SELECT
BLG.FORACID
,BLG.BANK_ID
,BLG.ACID
,BLG.LCHG_TIME
,BLGD.RECORD_STATUS
,BLG.INSERT_DTTM
FROM BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST_DELTA BLGD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG ON BLG.ACID = BLGD.ACID AND BLG.BANK_ID = BLGD.BANK_ID AND BLG.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping;


--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
FORACID
,BANK_ID
,ACID
,LCHG_TIME
)) HASHROW, FORACID, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CoreAccountId]
,[Timestamp]
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountMapping
),

TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FORACID, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,CASE
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_TGT TGT
ON SRC.FORACID = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT
SET
[CustomerAccountId] = SRC.FORACID
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.BANK_ID
,[CoreAccountId] = SRC.ACID
,[Timestamp] = SRC.LCHG_TIME
,[SOURCESYSTEMCODE] = 'LNS'
,[WORKFLOWID] = 0
,[TASKRUNID] = 0
,[INSERTDTTM] = SRC.INSERT_DTTM
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountMapping TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_coreCustomerAccountMapping SRC ON SRC.FORACID = TGT.CustomerAccountId;


INSERT INTO BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountMapping
(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CoreAccountId]
,[Timestamp]
,[SOURCESYSTEMCODE]
,[WORKFLOWID]
,[TASKRUNID]
,[INSERTDTTM]
)

SELECT
FORACID AS [CustomerAccountId]
,BANK_ID AS [FinancialInstitutionId]
,ACID AS [CoreAccountId]
,LCHG_TIME AS [Timestamp]
,'LNS' AS [SOURCESYSTEMCODE]
,0 AS [WORKFLOWID]
,0 AS [TASKRUNID]
,INSERT_DTTM AS [INSERTDTTM]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_DELTA;

END
